notes.title: Arcade Galaxy 1.4.0 Is Here! Get Ready for Even More Fun!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115465/d9a012f6187452ba2f21f2638c2fc52854073350.png[/img]
Thank you to all players for your support and feedback during our open test. This update brings major improvements and fixes to systems and core mechanics to enhance overall fluidity and enjoyment. Here’s what’s new:

New Features & Enhancements
	•	A brand-new tutorial system to help new players get started with ease. Returning players can access it from the menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115465/3b299b7ace5952e2bc865bfec1a5f6bafec74239.png[/img]
	•	New “Feeling Lucky” function to help you discover hidden map gems you might have missed.
	•	Map list now includes sorting by number of players — making it easier to find the most popular maps.
	•	Completion rate display has been reworked to reflect difficulty more intuitively, helping new players avoid unexpectedly brutal maps.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115465/3ee780435ee894a03b493550ab32f24b600c4fde.png[/img]

Gameplay Adjustments
	•	All skills now start with zero cooldown at match start, preventing spawn-based ambushes.
	•	Spike traps now have a smaller hitbox, allowing for more forgiving platforming.
	•	Wall climbing mechanics have been refined for a smoother yet more challenging experience.
	•	Rocket's explosion radius has been increased, making it easier to land a hit.

Bug Fixes & Stability Improvements
	•	Fixed an issue where the mouse cursor would disappear after a match.
	•	Resolved issues with skills not triggering correctly.
	•	Camera behavior improved after resizing the character.
	•	Fixed environmental jittering in certain scenes.
	•	Over 100 bug fixes and polish updates to skill feedback, spectator mode, multiplayer behavior, and UI presentation.

Official Maps
	•	“Autumn in New York” and “High & Dry” have been rebuilt to reflect the latest gameplay changes.
	•	Several new official maps have been added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115465/7ba339309225ebc7a3ceed17857272b5d53d6319.png[/img]

We’ll continue to make improvements based on your feedback and aim to provide a smoother, more stable, and more challenging experience. We’ll also be participating in the Steam Next Fest – Summer Edition starting June 9, 2025. We hope to bring you even more joy this summer!

Thanks again for your support and see you in Arcade Galaxy.

The Arcade Galaxy Team

notes.title: 🚀 Arcade Galaxy Beta 1.3 is Here with Major Updates!
notes.notes:
[h1]🚀 Arcade Galaxy Beta 1.3 Update Notes[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115465/aa31e98f334f11a0c1e04d4aefe8e8b8e3538952.png[/img]
Hey, creators and racers! This is Evan from the AG team, after months of closed beta with your help, we are thrilled to announce that Beta 1.3 is officially here! 🎉 This update brings smoother gameplay, exciting new features, and even more tools to unleash your creativity. Let’s dive into what’s new:

[h2]✨ Fixes: Smoother and More Reliable Gameplay[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181261/2854c927796de3fa3e56c5bea6062fb90fad6b97.png[/img]
	•	🔧 Fixed an issue where players were unexpectedly kicked from rooms during multiplaying.
	•	🛠️ Resolved errors in displaying information in multiplayer room.
	•	📂 Corrected permission issues for uploading/saving maps in the Map Editor.

💬 We’ve also been listening closely to your feedback about connectivity issues. With this update, we’ve made significant improvements to ensure a smoother and more reliable experience. We’re confident it works better than ever—jump in and try it out!

[h2]🏎️ Adjustments: Enhanced Gameplay[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181261/efa536551f367d4f7aa18f932f4b4efa11c8e7de.png[/img]
	•	🚗 Improved Cubs controls for a smoother and more snappy experience.
	•	⚙️ Refined object interaction mechanics to make gameplay feel even more responsive.

[h2]🎉 New Features: Level Up Your Creativity and Racing![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181261/aecba98aeca0e76a0862e646ca56fc82f3204d83.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181261/c7659951c92c6a3a9818d6c0d8699d6bdd095f1f.png[/img]
	•	🛠️ Brand-New Track Objects: Add even more flair and creativity to your tracks with new interactive elements!
	•	✨ Practical Templates: Build smarter and faster with newly added, more versatile Template combinations.
	•	👻 Ghost Cars in Single Player Mode: Race against the very bests in the world with this highly requested feature!
	•	🔄 Quick Respawn: Perfect for those nail-biting moments—press R to instantly get back in the action!

[h2]💡 Our Mission: Celebrating Creativity in Arcade Galaxy[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181261/72bf7649e2c14b16205270aa137eeda2def21940.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181261/248aec900123b3e8cea96d67960343951ba2d36e.png[/img]
Since launching the beta, we’ve been absolutely blown away by the amazing levels you’ve created. From mind-bending obstacle courses to wild, imaginative tracks, your creativity has far exceeded our expectations.

This is what Arcade Galaxy is all about—empowering you to build the tracks of your dreams. With this update, we’ve added even more tools to make that happen, and we’re more committed than ever to celebrating your creativity and pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. 🚀

We’re dedicated to making Arcade Galaxy the ultimate level build and sharing experience, and this update is another big step in that direction. Dive into the new features, challenge your friends, and let your imagination run wild on the tracks!

👉 Don’t forget to share your feedback and epic creations on our Discord! See you in Arcade Galaxy! 🏁
